bundle.title: Want missed calls *answered* too?
bundle.text: The bundle adds the Missed-Call AI Receptionist, shows its phone number on your site, and adds a chat box to your site. You save {bundle_save_setup} on setup and {bundle_save_monthly} a month.

faq.a: {price:WEB.setup} setup and {price:WEB.monthly} a month. The deposit is {price:WEB.deposit}; the rest is due before launch. The monthly fee covers keeping the site online and secure, checking that it's up, and 1 small edit per month.
We draft it with AI from your questionnaire answers, then you approve every page. Nothing goes live without your OK.
Yes. If you already have a domain, we connect it. If not, you register one in your own name and we show you how.

faq.q: Can I bring my own photos?
faq.a: Yes, and we recommend it. Real photos of your team and trucks work better than stock. We use stock photos only where you have none.

faq.q: Will it show up on Google?
faq.a: We set up the basics so Google can read your site: page titles and descriptions, your business details in Google's format, a list of your pages, Google's free site tools, and a link to your Google Business Profile. Where you rank depends on many things, so we can't promise a spot.

faq.q: What if I need more pages or Spanish?
faq.a: Extra pages are {price:ADD-PAGE.setup} each. A full Spanish version is {price:ADD-WEB-ES.setup} + {price:ADD-WEB-ES.monthly}/mo. Choosing an extra adds a short written quote step.

faq.q: Do I have to get on a call with you?

faq.a: The monthly plan cancels with {cancel_days} days' notice. {refund}
